messages:
Jo: Quick RFC follow-up: final sanity checklist for FP8/INT8/4bit rollouts. Short version below.
Rashid: fire away.
Jo: Canary: start 0.5% -> 1% after stable window. Shadow: 3% fidelity traces. Observation window: min(30m, 2500 reqs).
Tess: What auto-actions do we want?
Jo: Actions: catastrophic = immediate rollback if p99 latency +200ms OR error_rate +0.8%. Quality regression: ensemble delta (deg_score + token_coherence) > 1.5% OR snr_drop_db > 3 -> halve sample + alert; if still bad after 20m -> full rollback.
Rashid: Good. How compute SNR?
Jo: SNR = 10*log10(Var(baseline_embeddings) / Var(baseline - quantized)). Store baseline snapshots in eval-store.
Tess: Telemetry tags?
Jo: Require headers: X-Quant-Profile, X-Quant-Flags. Traces: trace.quant.profile, trace.quant.flags. Log snippet example: {"ts":"...","req":"r1","quant_profile":"fp8-x","deg_score":0.011,"snr_db":2.3}.
infra-bot: canary started: model=redwood-mosaic-fp8 canary=0.5% shadow=3%
Rashid: Fallback order? INT8 first or float32?
Jo: Fallback order: tenant_override -> INT8-compatible -> float32. Reason: try to preserve cost wins. Always log fallback decision.
Tess: CI rule?
Jo: PRs that change quant profiles must include: YAML canary block, shadow playback report, and runbook snippet. CI lints for missing items.
Rashid: Per-request first, per-token later behind feature flag. Good to ship.
Jo: I'll open PRs and post links here. Thanks.
